decision: Adopt the completed corrected parent as a valid exact-semantics SM120 component oracle. Preserve the original observer-failed terminal unchanged; no replay is authorized or needed.

observer_root_cause.detail: future_sm120_oracle.py captured stdout and stderr separately, then derived all three path flags exclusively by searching stderr_text. vLLM INFO backend-selection records were emitted to stdout, so the observer deterministically returned false despite preserving the required records.
observer_root_cause.contradiction_resolved: The candidate's earlier 'forcing TRITON_ATTN backend' message describes the model-level default. The pinned selector applies backend_per_kind afterward and gives the per-kind override precedence; the later resolved-backend records prove TRITON_ATTN for sliding_window and FLEX_ATTENTION for full_attention.

causal_chain: Gemma4Attention marks each layer sliding or full and constructs Attention with or without per_layer_sliding_window.
get_attn_backend maps that property to sliding_window or full_attention and applies attention_config.backend_per_kind before backend resolution.
CudaPlatform.get_attn_backend_cls validates the selected backend, emits 'Using AttentionBackendEnum.<backend> backend.', and returns that backend class; there is no fallback after this record.
Attention constructs a fixed backend implementation for the layer. The model runner groups metadata by each layer's get_attn_backend result.
Every Gemma4Attention.forward calls Attention; unified_attention_with_output dispatches directly to that layer's self.impl.forward.
TritonAttentionImpl.forward submits unified_attention. FlexAttentionImpl.forward submits flex_attention_compiled with FORCE_USE_FLEX_ATTENTION and has no Triton-attention fallback.

control_triton.direct_record: control.stdout contains two 'Using AttentionBackendEnum.TRITON_ATTN backend.' records and successful rows.
control_triton.supporting_runtime_record: control.stdout records JIT compilation of kernel_unified_attention and reduce_segments during inference.

candidate_triton.direct_record: candidate.stdout contains the parsed sliding_window=TRITON_ATTN mapping and 'Using AttentionBackendEnum.TRITON_ATTN backend.'.
candidate_triton.supporting_runtime_record: candidate.stdout records JIT compilation of kernel_unified_attention and reduce_segments during inference.

candidate_flex.direct_record: candidate.stdout contains the parsed full_attention=FLEX_ATTENTION mapping and 'Using AttentionBackendEnum.FLEX_ATTENTION backend.'.
candidate_flex.supporting_runtime_inference: The candidate completed all three prompts. Under the pinned eager dispatch chain, each of the ten full-attention layers calls its fixed FlexAttentionImpl, whose forward has no alternate attention backend.

evidence_labels.candidate_flex_consumption: derived from measured captures plus source-backed no-fallback dispatch
